AreaTargeting.Name: Place areas as Regions when casting
AreaTargeting.Hint: An ability with an area puts that area on the board to be aimed, then targets whoever is inside it, instead of asking you to select targets by hand first.

Scope.Name: Area targeting applies to
Scope.Hint: Abilities written for area targeting are always aimed. This decides which of the rest are.
Scope.Authored: Only abilities written for area targeting
Scope.Registered: Those, and the abilities other modules ask for

EnforceRange.Name: Enforce range
EnforceRange.Hint: Refuse a placement further from you than the ability reaches. Answering the question that follows can always place it anyway.

Review.Name: Review targets before casting
Review.Hint: Show the list of caught tokens for confirmation after you place the area. Turn this off to target everything the area caught and cast immediately.

Riders.Name: Apply riders automatically
Riders.Hint: When a save is rolled, a Strike lands, or damage is applied, apply what the ability's riders inflict. Requires a GM online; saves rolled from a chat card also require PF2e Toolbelt's Target Helper.

AutomateDeath.Name: Automate death effects
AutomateDeath.Hint: Some riders say "or die". Choose whom they may do that to; anyone else gets a whisper to the GM instead.

VanillaRiders.Name: Riders for vanilla spells
VanillaRiders.Hint: The conditions and effects this module applies for pf2e's own spells. PF2e Automations and PF2e Assistant automate some of the same spells; applying both would apply everything twice.
VanillaRiders.Uncovered: Only spells no other active module automates

Aim.TooClose: Those areas are too close together: their centres must be at least {feet} feet apart. Aim them again.
Aim.Failed: Area targeting failed; cast normally. See the console for details.
Aim.ShapeQuestion: {name} can be released as either shape. Which is it?
Aim.NoToken: {name} needs a token on the scene to originate from.
Aim.RequirementOne: {names} does not meet this ability's requirement
Aim.RequirementMany: {names} do not meet this ability's requirement
Aim.OutOfRange: {name} reaches {range} feet. That placement is {distance} feet away.
Aim.HintFromYou: {name}: {rule} — it starts at you; point where it goes.
Aim.ChainBroken: these targets don't form a chain — starting within {range} feet, each must be within {link} feet of the one before

Review.Title: Confirm targets
Review.Empty: Nothing in the area can be targeted.
Review.ReaimHint: Re-aim puts the area back on the cursor. Shift+scroll turns it, Ctrl+scroll turns it finely.

Encasement.Title: Encasement
Encasement.Encased: {target} is encased in {name} — Hardness {hardness}, {hp} Hit Points.
Encasement.EscapeDescription: Attempt an Athletics check against DC {dc} to break free of {link}. Destroying it does the same.

Escape.Name: Escape {name}
Escape.Description: Attempt a check — {skill} — against DC {dc} to break free of {name}. On a success you are released and this action goes away.
Escape.UnarmedNote: Pathfinder's Escape also allows an unarmed attack roll. A table that would rather roll that can, against the same DC.
Escape.Held: {actor} struggles against {held} and does not break free.

Banish.GoneForGood: {name} — {label}. It does not come back on its own.
Banish.GoneToSquare: {name} — {label}. It returns in {time}, to the square it left.
Banish.MissingScene: {name} was banished from a scene that no longer exists.
Banish.Label: Banished

Reaction.Decline: Ignoring this card declines the reaction; nothing is spent.

Overlap.Name: {item}: caught by {count}
Overlap.Description: Caught by {count} placements of {link} — {value} circumstance to the save it forces.

Lingering.FlyHint: Which way does {name} fly, and how far (up to {feet} feet)? Everyone whose space it passes over is hit.
Lingering.VineHint: Which creature does the vine lash at? Everyone within its reach of the creepers is offered.
Lingering.BoltHint: Where does the bolt fall? Every creature inside the storm is offered; the bolt strikes the one you choose.

Barrier.Lost: {name} is lost: {names} stand where it would go.
Barrier.Rubble: {name} is destroyed; its rubble is difficult terrain.
Barrier.Interposes: {name} takes the blow for {actor}: {taken} damage to it, {left} to {actor}.

Pull.Moved: {name} is pulled {feet} ft toward the centre (of {wanted}).

AreaDamage.Flavor: {item} — {type}, rolled once for everyone it reaches

Weapon.ChooseType: Which of {weapon}'s damage types? Spirit instead, if that would be worse for the creature (the GM's call).
Weapon.CritSpec: {name} is subject to {weapon}'s critical specialization effect: {text}

Actions.Choose: How many actions do you spend?
Actions.ChoosePerTarget: How many actions do you spend? One creature for each ({targets} targeted).
Actions.TooManyTargets: {name} reaches at most {max} creatures; {targets} are targeted.

Fall.Fell: {actor} falls {feet} feet, safely; still {left} feet up.
Fall.Landed: {actor} falls {feet} feet to the ground, safely.

Cleanse.Title: Cleanse
Cleanse.Nothing: No affliction on the target to ease.
Cleanse.Already: {name} has already been eased once; only a counteract can do more.
Cleanse.FirstStage: {name} is at its first stage; there is no stage to take off.
Cleanse.Beyond: {name} is beyond this casting: it can't be eased, and its kind can't be counteracted at this rank.

Unobserved.Name: {watcher} can't observe {hidden}
Unobserved.FlatPassed: {attacker} attacks {hidden}, whom it can't observe: DC 11 flat check — passed.
Unobserved.FlatFailed: {attacker} attacks {hidden}, whom it can't observe: DC 11 flat check — failed, the attack is lost.

Aftermath.NoneDied: {name} killed no one: the void energy turns back.

OriginAction.Description: {name}: from {target}, the creature {spell} marked. Each use spends one.
OriginAction.Last: {name}: the last one — the spell ends.

Rays.Penalty: {name}'s multiple attack penalty now counts {count} more attacks.
Rays.PenaltyOne: {name}'s multiple attack penalty now counts one more attack.

Requires.FlyingTarget: {name} needs a target in the air.

Dismiss.Name: Dismiss {name}
Dismiss.Description: Dismiss {name}: what it left — an area, or an effect — ends.

Transfer.Ended: {from} is at 0 Hit Points: the link ends.

FastHealing.Off: {actor} took acid or fire damage: no regeneration this turn.
FastHealing.Withheld: {actor} gains no benefit from regeneration or fast healing while {name} lasts.

Summon.None: {name}: nothing in the Monster Cores can be summoned at this rank.
Summon.Occupied: That space is taken by {names}: a summoned creature appears in an open space.

Concealed.FlatPassed: {attacker} targets {target}, concealed: the DC 5 flat check succeeds.
Concealed.FlatFailed: {attacker} targets {target}, concealed: the DC 5 flat check fails, and the attack misses.

Nudge.Label: {name}
Nudge.Spent: {name}: {actor}'s roll was nudged, and the spell ends.

ShareDamage.Took: {actor} takes {damage} damage through the link with {target}.
ShareDamage.Zero: {name} ends: one of the linked creatures is at 0 Hit Points.
ShareDamage.Apart: {name} ends: the linked creatures are too far apart.

SpellShield.Took: {name}: the shield takes {taken} damage ({hp}/{max} Hit Points left).
SpellShield.Destroyed: {name}: the shield takes {taken} damage and is destroyed.

ShieldBlock.Ended: {actor} blocked with the shield: {name} ends, and it can't be cast again for 10 minutes.

Decoy.You: The attack finds {actor} — not an image.
Decoy.Image: The attack strikes an image of {actor} instead: no effect on them. {left} left.
Decoy.ImageCrit: An image of {actor} is destroyed, and the critical hit becomes a hit on them. {left} left.
Decoy.ImageMiss: The attack misses {actor} but destroys an image, with no other effect. {left} left.

Deters.Barred: {attacker} can't attack {target} under {ward}: the action is wasted.
Deters.Wasted: {attacker} fails the save against {ward}: the attack on {target} is wasted, and so is any other this turn.
Deters.BarredForGood: {attacker} critically fails against {ward}: the action is wasted, and {attacker} can't attack {target} while it lasts.
Deters.Allowed: {attacker} succeeds against {ward}: attacks on {target} go ahead this turn.

Sustain.Name: Sustain {name}
Sustain.Description: Sustain {name}: its effect grows one step. Once per round, and not in the round it was cast.
Sustain.NotYet: {name} can't be Sustained in the round it was cast.
Sustain.Already: {name} has already been Sustained this round.
Sustain.Gone: {name} has ended; there is nothing to Sustain.
Sustain.KeepDescription: Sustain {name}: it lasts while you do. Once per round, and not in the round it was cast; a turn that ends without it ends the spell.

Relay.NoGM: {name}: no GM is online, so its riders were not applied. Apply them by hand.

Move.DragShort: {name} is pulled {feet} feet closer — the {travel}-foot drag ran out of map.
Move.ThrowShort: {name} is pulled {feet} feet away — the {travel}-foot throw ran out of map.
Move.PushShort: {name} is pushed {feet} feet — something stopped the {travel}-foot push.

Strikes.MissingOne: {item} could not find {missing} on the sheet, so that Strike was not made.
Strikes.MissingMany: {item} could not find {missing} on the sheet, so those Strikes were not made.

Heal.Capped: Nothing more to give — {actor} has drawn all {cap} Hit Points this casting allows.
Heal.Pooled: {actor} regains {healed} Hit Points ({so} of {cap} this casting).
Heal.Full: {actor} is already at full Hit Points.

Toggle.Title: Toggle
Toggle.Missing: No "{option}" toggle to flip — set it by hand.

Counteract.Title: Counteract
Counteract.Nothing: Nothing with {traits} to counteract in the area.
Counteract.NoSpellEffect: No spell effect on the target to counteract.
Counteract.NoStatistic: {actor} has no {slug} statistic to counteract with.
Counteract.Floor: {effect} cannot be counteracted below rank {floor} — a counteract rank of {rank} does not touch it.
Counteract.CannotSuppress: {effect} could not be suppressed without stranding a grant.
Counteract.Suppressed: {effect} is suppressed {until}, and cannot be re-entered until then.
Counteract.UntilNextTurn: until the end of {actor}'s next turn
Counteract.Holds: {effect} holds — rank {rank} against a counteract rank of {ours} on a {outcome}.
Counteract.NearMiss: {effect} is not counteracted, but suppressed until the start of {actor}'s next turn; its duration does not run meanwhile.

Readout.Title: What the senses tell
Readout.Nothing: Nothing living or dead within {range} feet.
Readout.Gone: There is nothing left to read.

Riders.StandDown: Isaac's Homebrew is older than 1.1.0 and runs its own rider engine, so this module's is off. Update Isaac's Homebrew to use this one.

Indicator.Tooltip: Automated by Isaac's PF2e Automation — click to see what happens
Indicator.Title: {name}: what is automated
Indicator.NotOwned: Switches work on an item owned by an actor or in the world, not on a compendium's.
Indicator.Shapes: Choose one of {count} shapes as you cast
Indicator.Overlap: A penalty for being caught by more than one placement
Indicator.Bypass: Ignores resistances or immunities, as written
Indicator.Requires: Refused when what it needs is missing
Indicator.VariantFromWeapon: Its damage type from the weapon in hand
Indicator.ActionVariants: Cast with {counts} actions, the variant for each
Indicator.TargetsPerAction: A creature for each action spent
Indicator.SameAttackPenalty: Every attack of the cast at one penalty
Indicator.CastChoice: One of {count} choices, made as it is cast

Key.castChoice: A choice as it is cast

Source.Table: From Isaac's PF2e Automation's vanilla table
Source.Deferred: Left to {module}, which already automates this spell
Source.SettingOff: Off: the "Riders for vanilla spells" setting

command.Failure: On its next turn, the target must spend its first action doing as commanded: approach, run away, release what it holds, drop prone, or stand in place.
command.CriticalFailure: On its next turn, the target must spend all its actions obeying the command.

calm.Failure: The target can't use hostile actions, and emotion effects on it are suppressed — until another creature is hostile to it.
calm.CriticalFailure: The target can't use hostile actions, and emotion effects on it are suppressed, even if others are hostile to it.

grease.Area: An area: four squares of grease
grease.Object: A target: one object (target it yourself)
grease.ObjectFailure: The holder or wielder takes a –2 circumstance penalty to checks that involve using the greased object.
grease.ObjectCriticalFailure: The holder or wielder releases the greased object; it lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice.
grease.BalanceFailure: Moving onto the grease, it failed to Balance: it must stop, or fall prone to keep going.

translocate.Alone: If this would bring another creature along — even inside an extradimensional container — the spell is lost.

wall-of-fire.Line: A wall: a straight line up to 60 feet

darkness.Inside: You are within heightened darkness: even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) treat you as concealed, and you treat targets seen through the darkness as concealed.

laughing-fit.Helpless: helpless with laughter: can't use actions or reactions

petrify.Incapacitation: Petrify's ongoing save has the incapacitation trait; a creature of a much higher level than the spell may improve its result by one step.

blindness.AlreadyImmune: The target is temporarily immune to blindness and is unaffected.

sleep.Heightened: Heightened sleep: it can't attempt Perception checks to wake up, and when the duration ends it is sleeping normally instead of waking.

wave-of-despair.Despair: despair: no reactions, a Will save at the start of each turn

vision-of-death.Real: its vision becomes reality, and it dies.

guidance.AlreadyImmune: The target is temporarily immune to Guidance: the spell does nothing.

protection.Choose: Ward only the target, or every ally within 10 feet of it as well?

levitate.Way: Move it up or down 10 feet?

seal-fate.Choose: Which damage will be its end?

disintegrate.Powder: it is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

telekinetic-maneuver.Prompt: Which maneuver, with your spell attack?

tangling-creepers.Slowed: –10 feet to land, climb and swim Speeds among the creepers.

hypnotize.NoReactions: fascinated by the cloud: no reactions

toxic-cloud.Inside: Concealed in the toxic cloud, and everything outside it concealed from you.

shield.Immune: You can't cast shield again yet: it ended with a Shield Block less than 10 minutes ago.

sure-strike.AlreadyImmune: You are temporarily immune to sure strike: this casting has no effect.

banishment.Week: It can't return by any means to the plane it was banished from for 1 week.
banishment.Cost: Paid the extra action and an anathema cost? The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save — apply it before rolling. The spell fails if you aren't on your home plane.

gust-of-wind.Success: The creature can't move against the wind.
gust-of-wind.Flying: If the creature was flying, it takes the effects of a critical failure instead (pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, prone, 2d6 bludgeoning).

mist.Inside: You are within the mist: you are concealed, and creatures outside the mist are concealed to you.
